readback.title: 5 Ton Diesel Wheeled Backhoe Loader 4x4 HW20-28 with 75 kW Engine, 1 m³ Bucket, 2600 mm Digging Depth, High Load Moment for Construction and Agriculture
bullets: 5 Ton Capacity Backhoe Loader: Designed for heavy-duty road construction and agricultural tasks, this diesel-powered wheeled backhoe loader delivers robust performance with a 5-ton operating capacity and 75 kW (100.58 hp) Yunnei engine.
4x4 Wheeled Chassis: All-terrain 4x4 wheel drive system provides enhanced traction and stability on uneven Canadian terrain, including gravel roads, muddy fields, and snow-affected job sites.
High Load Moment Design: Engineered for superior lifting and digging leverage, supporting maximum digging depth of 2600 mm, digging radius up to 4600 mm, and unloading height of 2300 mm.
Hydraulic System by Trusted Brands: Features Bosch Rexroth hydraulic cylinders, Kawasaki hydraulic pump, and Hengli hydraulic valves for precise, responsive, and durable hydraulic control.

Compact Articulated Frame: Ultra-maneuverable articulated design achieves a minimum turning radius of 4500 mm, ideal for tight spaces in barns, urban construction zones, and residential landscaping projects.
